description: Precedent search over judgment records — the read side that makes recording pay for itself. Slice A: trace the causal chain behind a position by walking the ledger (mechanical, no embeddings, unblocked). Slice B: semantic similarity over position statements to surface precedent for a new call, the natural bridge to the SmartMemory coupling. BLOCKED for slice B until the SmartMemory recall failure (19/20 drop) is root-caused. Depends on COMP-JUDGMENT-BITEMPORAL: a precedent is only useful if you can see what was believed AT decision time. Anchor: docs/features/COMP-JUDGMENT-PRECEDENT/plan.md
